Definition: from G5228 and G837; to increase above ordinary degree:--grow exceedingly.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses hyperauxánō where we would say to grow exceedingly, to increase greatly. In 2 Thessalonians 1:3, the text says "because that your faith groweth exceedingly."
TheologicalSignificance: I read hyperauxánō plainly — it means to grow exceedingly, to increase greatly, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
